totals.description: Points banked, indexed by side. Only the player who has just stopped can have 100 or more, and then the game is over; the schema cannot say that, the server checks it.

turn_total.description: This turn's rolls so far, last_roll included: last_roll, or last_roll plus at least 2.

last_roll.description: The roll to_move is deciding on. After a 1 the only move is to stop.
